description: The Page, Knight, Queen and King of Swords in tarot: upright and reversed meanings, and how court cards can be people, aspects of yourself or approaches.
lede: The Swords court cards describe four ways of using the mind, from the curious Page to the fair-minded King. They can be people, parts of you or approaches.

faces.alt: Four original gold-linework tarot card faces in a row: Page, Knight, Queen and King of Swords in order. Each shows its rank and a sword icon, with the card name beneath. There are no scenes or published artwork.
faces.caption: The four ranks show four ways of using thought and speech. Ask which one a situation is calling for, and which one you tend to overuse.
